messages:
Priya (CSM): FYI — VantEdge onboarding healthcheck: they’re showing 99.5% uptime last 7d vs the 99.9% in the onboarding SLA. Need to gather evidence and a proposed credit calc for renewal comms. @Liam can you pull the uptime + region breakdown? :eyes:
Liam (SRE): On it. Which time window exactly? last 7d or since go-live on 03/08?
Priya (CSM): start with last 7d, then if there’s a clear degradation slice to go-live. We need per-region and per-cluster metrics.
Marisol (Onboarding): they were routed to the EU cluster during rollout until 03/12, then traffic shifted. Might be sticky sessions causing re-routes — I can share rollout notes.
Ethan (Support): Logged INC-4721 for a latency spike on 2026-03-14 01:12 UTC — linked traces here: https://internal.traces/redwood/INC-4721 and the support doc: https://redwood.app/support/INC-4721
deploy-bot: Deployment v2.3.8 completed to eu-west-1 at 2026-03-12T02:04:21Z :white_check_mark:
Liam (SRE): pulling queries now. quick SQL to grab the window I’ll use:
```
SELECT region, cluster, bin(time, 1h) as hr, AVG(uptime_pct) as uptime
FROM service_uptime
WHERE service = 'inference-api' AND time >= '2026-03-08'
GROUP BY region, cluster, hr
ORDER BY hr
```
Priya (CSM): perfect. Also capture error budget burn and any fallback events (model fallbacks, cross-region failovers). Those are part of the SLA evidence bundle.
Sofia (AE): Heads-up — VantEdge raised a renewal concern in last call. If we quantify the credit proactively and attach mitigation steps, it helps the renewal conversation.
Marisol (Onboarding): I’ll attach the rollout checklist and the sticky-session config we used. Might explain cross-cluster blips.
Ethan (Support): I’ll export the incident timeline + customer-facing comms we already sent. Quick note: they received a single brief notice on 03/14 at 02:00 UTC.
Liam (SRE): Attached: raw uptime CSV + hourly aggregates. Early glance shows a ~0.25% dip centered in eu-west-1 around 2026-03-14 01:00-03:00 UTC. No full cluster outage, more elevated error rates.
Priya (CSM): Can you also compute the provisional credit by our SLA formula? (example: pro-rated credit = max(0, floor((SLA_target - observed)/SLA_target * monthly_fee))) — we’ll need both conservative and generous numbers.
Liam (SRE): I’ll run the calc and include the error-budget timeline.
Marisol (Onboarding): Proposed remediation notes: sticky-session fix rolled out 03/12, adding health-check ramp and a small traffic-shift rollback plan if needed. I’ll include action items for customer enablement.
Priya (CSM): Timeline: can we prepare a one-pager evidence bundle + credit calc by EOD tomorrow? I’ll sync with Sofia for renewal messaging after that. :+1:
Sofia (AE): I’ll draft the renewal note template and include the one-pager.
Ethan (Support): If we decide to offer any goodwill credit beyond the SLA formula, flag Support + Finance for approval.
Liam (SRE): Will send the compiled bundle (csv, graphs, incident timeline, calc) to this thread by 10:30 UTC tomorrow.
Priya (CSM): Thanks team. Once bundle is in, I’ll run it past legal if we deviate from standard credit calc. Leaving this thread open for updates. :memo:
